facts.text: Georgia is the birthplace of wine, with archaeological evidence of winemaking dating back 8,000 years.
The Georgian language features its own unique 33-letter alphabet that is used nowhere else on Earth.
Locals don't actually call their country 'Georgia', their official name for their homeland is Sakartvelo.
Home to Veryovkina, the deepest natural cave on Earth, dropping over 2,200 meters into the ground.
The country got its name because it is the world’s largest producer of gold leaf and gold foil.
